datasets.title: Ethiopia population Density
datasets.description: This dataset represents the estimated population density of Ethiopia in the year 2020 , expressed as the number of people per square kilometer. It is intended to support spatial analysis and decision-making in areas such as disaster risk reduction, resource allocation, development planning, and vulnerability assessment Source - WORLDPOP Relationship to Exposure- (Positive)- The higher the population, the higher the exposure.
